page.layout: One page of text, all centred: a decorative printed border at the top, then the dedication title in capitals and small capitals, a salutation line, the closing title lines, and the dedicator's name at the foot. No margins, running head or page number.

page.notes: The top border is a printed ornament, not text, so it is not transcribed. Faint show-through and ink blotches appear on the page (near "SUIS" and at the lower right) and are left out. The "Dn." abbreviation is copied as printed. The name line is set in a different type size and is given as a paragraph, not a heading.
